meta.title: Download tdownloader - Windows, macOS and Linux
hero.title: Download tdownloader
hero.subtitle: Download tdownloader, install it on your system and create your Telegram credentials. Every step, with its screenshot, so there are no doubts.
toc.title: On this page
win.title: Install on Windows
win.intro: When you open the installer, Windows shows a blue SmartScreen warning. This is completely normal: it appears with any new app that does not yet have a paid signing certificate. The app is safe; you just need to tell Windows to continue.
win.s1: Double-click the tdownloader-setup.exe file you downloaded.
win.s2: The blue screen Windows protected your PC appears. Click the More info link.
win.s3: The app name is shown and a new button appears. Click Run anyway.
win.s4: Continue the installer as usual and open tdownloader.
win.note: The first time you open the app it may take a few seconds to show your channels while Windows scans it. If the sidebar looks empty, wait a moment: it fills in on its own once the program finishes starting.
win.alt1: SmartScreen warning “Windows protected your PC” with the More info link
win.alt2: SmartScreen with the Run anyway button
mac.title: Install on macOS
mac.intro: macOS may say the app is damaged and can’t be opened (or that it is from an unidentified developer). It is not damaged: it is the Gatekeeper protection blocking apps that do not yet have Apple’s paid signature. It takes 10 seconds to fix.
mac.alt: macOS alert: the app is damaged and can't be opened
mac.cap: If you see this alert, do NOT click Move to Trash. Click Cancel and follow the steps.
mac.s1: Drag tdownloader to your Applications folder. In the alert, click Cancel (NOT Move to Trash).
mac.s2: Open the Terminal app (in Applications → Utilities, or with Spotlight: Cmd+Space and type Terminal). Paste this command and press Enter:
mac.s2note: It removes the quarantine flag that macOS adds to downloads. It asks for no password and, if it works, shows no message.
mac.s3: Open tdownloader normally (double-click). It will no longer complain.
mac.note: If instead of damaged it only says unidentified developer, just right-click (or Control+click) the app → Open → Open. Only the first time.

api.title: Create your API ID and API Hash
api.intro: Telegram requires personal credentials (an API ID and an API Hash) for apps to access your account. You create them once, they are free and take a minute. Telegram’s page is in English; here is every step with its screenshot.
api.s1: Go to my.telegram.org. Enter your phone number in international format (with the country code, for example +34611223344) and click Next.
api.cap1: Your number with country code → Next.
api.alt1: my.telegram.org: enter the phone number in international format
api.s2: Telegram sends a login code to your Telegram app (NOT by SMS). Open Telegram on your phone or computer: in the official Telegram chat you will see a message with your Web login code.
api.cap2: The code arrives inside Telegram, in the Telegram chat.
api.alt2: Telegram message with the Web login code
api.s3: Go back to my.telegram.org, type that code in Confirmation code and click Sign In.
api.alt3: my.telegram.org: enter the confirmation code and click Sign In
api.alt4: Your Telegram Core: API development tools option
api.s5: Fill in the Create new application form with these values and click Create application:
api.t_apptitle: tdownloader
api.t_shortname: tdownloader (5 to 32 letters or digits)
api.t_desc: tdownloader app (or leave it blank)
api.cap5: Fill it in like this and click Create application.
api.alt5: Create new application form: App title and Short name tdownloader, Platform Desktop
api.s6: You will see two values: App api_id (a number) and App api_hash (a long string of letters and digits). Copy both. They are the only ones you need.
api.cap6: Copy App api_id and App api_hash.
api.alt6: App configuration: copy App api_id and App api_hash
api.s7: Go back to tdownloader: paste the api_id into the API ID field and the api_hash into API Hash, add your phone number and click Send code. Done!
api.note: These credentials are yours and stay on your computer. tdownloader never sends them to our servers: they only connect your machine directly to Telegram, just like the official app.
